locator: GoedelVariantHOML1.thy, Ax1: "⌊P φ ❙∧ P ψ ❙⊃ P (φ ❙. ψ)⌋"
interpretation: Axiom Ax1 as stated in the theory, with ❙. the conjunction of properties (HOMLinHOL.thy, Mconpred) and the free φ, ψ read as universally closed, as Isabelle does. Attributed to the AFP formalization of Gödel's 1970 manuscript (Benzmüller and Scott), not to what Gödel intended.
